title: Thanks for the tips the other day. Took a step back from vibe coding and trying python for my Rogue game idea
author: Left-Excitement3829
selftext:
I posted the other day with my vibe effort. And you were all cool about it and pointed out some issues. I decided to step back and revisit the concept. Ironically making it vastly simpler made it easier to code in python , only 1 room for now , but I made it and it worked ! And it doesn’t look like every other vibe coded Indy effort. I know ai is not looked upon fondly , but do ppl use LLM as code checkers ? Because one thing was baffling me and I threw it into gpt and it gave me the fix fir it ( I was trying to reference a tileset that I forgot to install to a folder ) 

Thanks again

comments.author: ScutFarkush
comments.body: Most people do not care if you use ai and you build something of actual quality. Don’t let the reddit hive mind( and bots) scare you. The real world is not Reddit as much as reddit users do not want to believe this.

replies.author: Left-Excitement3829
replies.body: Truth. I’m just going to forge on and hopefully get something fun at the end of the

comments.author: Azerax
comments.body:
A year ago I would tell people to manually check every line of code written by ai. Now I tell them to have ai check every line of code they write.   
Great code can’t save a crappy design though

replies.author: Left-Excitement3829
replies.body: That’s what I’m discovering. I’m hoping what I made is “ fun “ I’m enjoying it , and learning python by osmosis
